{"code": "rows_5n = get_rows('Source data figure 5.xlsx', '5n')
rows_5o = get_rows('Source data figure 5.xlsx', '5o')
pid = [r[0] for r in rows_5n[2:]]
vopt = {r[0]: (r[4]+r[5]+r[6])/3 for r in rows_5n[2:]}
topt = {r[0]: (r[4]+r[5]+r[6])/3 for r in rows_5o[2:]}
cv, ct = 48.97, 50.47
pred_res = [p for p in pid if vopt[p] > cv and topt[p] > ct]
print('predicted resistant (both cutoffs):', pred_res, len(pred_res))
truth_res = ['P11','P12','P13','P14','P32','P34','P35','P36','P37','P38','P39']
TP = len(set(pred_res) & set(truth_res)); FP = len(set(pred_res) - set(truth_res))
TN = 11 - FP; FN = 11 - TP
print('TP,FP,TN,FN =', TP, FP, TN, FN)
print('sens', TP/11, 'spec', TN/11, 'acc', (TP+TN)/22)
"}
